name: Ono no Takamura
source:
Died at the age of 34.

He's been working for [url=https://vndb.org/c107327]King Enma[/url] since his past life, and was dragged into Hell after death to continue his job. Claims to be the first ever corporate slave. Served by two demon flames, Agyo and Ungyo.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/tengoku/characters/ono-no-takamura/]Aksys Games[/url]]
